Added `migrations/0042_search_trgm_index.sql` (enables `pg_trgm` and builds a GIN trigram index on `products.name`, concurrently so it doesn't lock the table) and applied it.

Benchmark (`make bench-search`, 2000 requests, 16 workers, 0 errors):

| | before | after |
|---|---|---|
| p50 | 310ms | 118ms |
| p95 | 480ms | 163ms |
| throughput | 48 rps | 122 rps |

p95 is now comfortably under the 200ms budget, so the slow search is fixed.
